notes.subject: ברוך אתה
notes.rationale: Lit. 'kneeled/blessed are you'; rendered with 'dubatigi' (giver of blessing) — a shape change to make the adjective attributive

notes.subject: חקיך
notes.rationale: חוק is an enacted statute/appointment; rendered 'sariya kuntilenna' (inscribed statutes) to keep the enactment sense distinct from Torah as a whole

notes.subject: למדני
notes.rationale: Imperative petition: 'teach me' — a direct request to Yawe

translation: I ye dubatigiw ye, Yawe; i k'a kalan ne ye i sariyaw kuntilenna.
